label: lem:antideriv_diff_zero_deriv
title: Difference of antiderivatives has zero derivative
statement: If $F$ and $G$ are both antiderivatives of $f$ on $(a,b)$, then $\texttt{HasDerivAt}\; (F - G)\; 0\; x$ for all $x \in (a,b)$.
proof: By \texttt{HasDerivAt.sub}, the derivative of $F - G$ at $x$ is $f(x) - f(x) = 0$.
